title: CRITICAL: capstone dogfood — author a basic Flash game end-to-end and verify in Ruffle
description:
DONE (commits 526d6f0, c2579eb). All four Oracle gate points hold in ONE passing run.

Run command + result:
  cd apps/desktop && npx playwright test e2e/capstone-0519.spec.ts --reporter=line
  => 1 passed (8.1s)
  Full e2e suite: 74 passed. Unit suites: core 4435 / swf 881 / authoring-ui 175 passed.

(1) GRANULAR MCP AUTHORING: the test authors Coin Dash via real MCP callTool round-trips only — doc_set_properties, doc_summary, stage_add_shape (player/coin/panel rects), library_convert_to_symbol (Player, Coin MCs), stage_update (position + instanceName + keyDown clipActions), stage_add_text (dynamic 'Score: 0' named scoreText + static GAME OVER), timeline_insert_blank_keyframe (frame 2), script_set (game script frame 1, stop() frame 2; diagnostics []), publish_swf. Structure asserted via doc_summary/script_list before pixels.
(2) REAL MECHANICS: _root.onEnterFrame game loop, Key input via onClipEvent(keyDown) this._x += 60 (Key.isDown/getCode polling is broken in bundled headless Ruffle 0.1.0 — documented limitation, keyDown event is the proven path from 0703), MovieClip.hitTest(coin), score in dynamic TextField (_root.scoreText.text = 'Score: ' + _root.score), gotoAndStop(2) game-over.
(3) KEYBOARD DRIVES THE GAME: test asserts no movement without input (no auto-chase), then page.keyboard ArrowRight moves player +60 (blueBox x tracked), 5 presses -> hitTest -> score TextField pixels change + player resets, 15 presses -> score 3.
(4) SCORE TEXTFIELD VISIBLY INCREMENTS: ink pixels asserted in score region on load; region pixel diff after first coin > threshold ('Score: 0' -> 'Score: 1').
(5) GAME-OVER VIA GAMEPLAY: score >= 3 -> gotoAndStop(2); red panel pixels appear, player/coin pixels vanish. No trigger SWF.

DOGFOOD FINDINGS (the reason this task exists) — three compiler/encoder bugs found and fixed:
  a) AS2 opcode table had 15 wrong values incl. SetMember/GetMember SWAPPED, Add2=0x64(BitRShift), Not=0x14(StringLength), Increment=0x47(Add2) — every member write/read, +, !, ++ was broken at runtime; ~700 unit-test assertions had codified the wrong bytes (task 0706, commit 526d6f0).
  b) DefineFunction2/Try declared lengths wrongly included trailing bodies; Ruffle logged 'Length mismatch in AVM1 action' and re-synced past the actions FOLLOWING the record — the onEnterFrame assignment was silently skipped. This (not a headless-Ruffle limitation) is why earlier closures believed onEnterFrame did not run. ActionTry field order also fixed (flags, sizes, THEN catch name).
  c) Named text fields were placed without a PlaceObject2 name so _root.scoreText was unreachable from AS2; compile.ts now emits encodePlaceObject2WithName for text with instanceName.
All recorded in CLAUDE.md Learnings. Regression suites: memberassign.test.ts (opcode table pinned to ruffle/swf/src/avm1/opcode.rs; Ruffle-style action-stream walker pinning DefineFunction2/With/Try length conventions).
Debug tip recorded: Ruffle load config logLevel:'info' surfaces AVM1 trace() in the console.
